{"name":"Snowflake to SqlServer Complex queries","engineVariableName":"","components":[{"udfNames":[],"componentId":0,"componentName":"startComponent","tableName":"","category":"Start","componentType":"UDF","rank":0,"dataSourceName":"","displayRows":0,"dependencies":[],"className":"com.datagaps.dataflow.models.UDFComponent","executionOption":"","excludeNotification":"Y"},{"partitionOptions":{"partitionType":"","name":""},"enableTrim":"N","easyQueryDefJson":{"sqlQuery":""},"isAutoRepartition":"Y","databaseName":"DEMO_DB","failComponentWhenDatasetEmpty":"N","maskDataColumns":"","componentId":3,"componentName":"Snowflake Raw","tableName":"Snowflake_Raw","category":"Source","componentType":"JDBC","rank":0,"dataSourceName":"Snowflake_QA_New","displayRows":50,"dependencies":[],"options":{"dbTable":"SELECT
    l.LOAN_ID,
    l.FARMER_ID,

    l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD,
    l.INTEREST_RATE_PERCENT,
    UPPER(TRIM(LOAN_TYPE)) as LOAN_TYPE,
    c.TYPE AS COLLATERAL_TYPE,
    c.VALUE_USD AS COLLATERAL_VALUE_USD,

    cr.CROP_TYPE,
    cr.RISK_LEVEL,

    c.VALUE_USD / l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD AS COLLATERAL_COVERAGE_RATIO,

    CASE 
        WHEN c.VALUE_USD < l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD
            THEN 'HIGH RISK'
        WHEN cr.RISK_LEVEL = 'HIGH'
            THEN 'MEDIUM RISK'
        ELSE 'LOW RISK'
    END AS FINAL_RISK_LEVEL

FROM LOANS_BRONZE l
LEFT JOIN COLLATERAL_BRONZE c
    ON l.LOAN_ID = c.LOAN_ID
LEFT JOIN CROPS_BRONZE cr
    ON l.FARMER_ID = cr.FARMER_ID;"},"className":"com.datagaps.dataflow.models.JDBCComponent","dataSourceLogicalName":"","executionOption":"","excludeNotification":"N"},{"partitionOptions":{"partitionType":"","name":""},"enableTrim":"N","easyQueryDefJson":{"sqlQuery":""},"isAutoRepartition":"Y","databaseName":"","failComponentWhenDatasetEmpty":"N","maskDataColumns":"","componentId":5,"componentName":"SQL Server Target","tableName":"SQL_Server_Target","category":"Source","componentType":"JDBC","rank":0,"dataSourceName":"Microsoft SQL Server_Adv2014","displayRows":50,"dependencies":[],"options":{"dbTable":"SELECT
    l.LOAN_ID,
    l.FARMER_ID,

    -- Clean numeric values
    COALESCE(l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD, 0) AS LOAN_AMOUNT_USD,
    COALESCE(l.INTEREST_RATE_PERCENT, 0) AS INTEREST_RATE_PERCENT,

    -- Clean text
    COALESCE(TRIM(UPPER(l.LOAN_TYPE)), 'UNKNOWN') AS LOAN_TYPE,

    -- Collateral
    COALESCE(TRIM(UPPER(c.TYPE)), 'UNKNOWN') AS COLLATERAL_TYPE,
    COALESCE(c.VALUE_USD, 0) AS COLLATERAL_VALUE_USD,

    -- Crop data (NO NULLS exposed)
    COALESCE(
        UPPER(LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(cr.CROP_TYPE)), 1)) +
        LOWER(SUBSTRING(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(cr.CROP_TYPE)),
            2,
            LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(cr.CROP_TYPE)))
        )),
        'UNKNOWN'
    ) AS CROP_TYPE,
    COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(cr.RISK_LEVEL)), 'UNKNOWN') AS RISK_LEVEL,

    -- Coverage ratio (safe division)
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD,0) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(
            COALESCE(c.VALUE_USD,0) / l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD,
            2
        )
    END AS COLLATERAL_COVERAGE_RATIO,

    -- Final risk logic
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD,0) = 0 
            THEN 'UNKNOWN'

        WHEN COALESCE(c.VALUE_USD,0) < COALESCE(l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD,0)
            THEN 'HIGH RISK'

        WHEN COALESCE(UPPER(TRIM(cr.RISK_LEVEL)), 'UNKNOWN') = 'HIGH'
            THEN 'MEDIUM RISK'

        WHEN COALESCE(c.VALUE_USD,0) >= COALESCE(l.LOAN_AMOUNT_USD,0)
            THEN 'LOW RISK'

        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS FINAL_RISK_LEVEL,

    -- Optional data quality flag (very useful)
    CASE 
        WHEN cr.CROP_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_CROP_DATA'
        ELSE 'VALID'
    END AS DATA_QUALITY_FLAG

FROM LOANS_SILVER l

LEFT JOIN COLLATERAL_SILVER c
    ON l.LOAN_ID = c.LOAN_ID

LEFT JOIN CROPS_SILVER cr
    ON l.FARMER_ID = cr.FARMER_ID;"},"className":"com.datagaps.dataflow.models.JDBCComponent","dataSourceLogicalName":"","executionOption":"","excludeNotification":"N"},{"sourceDataFrame":"Snowflake_Raw","targetDataFrame":"SQL_Server_Target","mapping":[{"sourceColumn":"LOAN_ID","sourceType":"string","sourceDataFormat":"","sourceTypeChange":"N","originalSourceType":"string","targetColumn":"LOAN_ID","targetType":"string","targetDataFormat":"","targetTypeChange":"N","orginalTargetType":"string","unique":"Y","upperThreshold":0.0,"lowerThreshold":0.0,"thresholdUnit":"","hasThreshold":"N","columnOrder":0},{"sourceColumn":"FARMER_ID","sourceType":"string","sourceDataFormat":"","sourceTypeChange":"N","originalSourceType":"string","targetColumn":"FARMER_ID","targetType":"string","targetDataFormat":"","targetTypeChange":"N","orginalTargetType":"string","unique":"Y","upperThreshold":0.0,"lowerThreshold":0.0,"thresholdUnit":"","hasThreshold":"N","columnOrder":1},{"sourceColumn":"LOAN_AMOUNT_USD","sourceType":"decimal(38,0)","sourceDataFormat":"","sourceTypeChange":"N","originalSourceType":"decimal(38,0)","targetColumn":"LOAN_AMOUNT_USD","targetType":"decimal(12,2)","targetDataFormat":"","targetTypeChange":"N","orginalTargetType":"decimal(12,2)","unique":"N","upperThreshold":0.0,"lowerThreshold":0.0,"thresholdUnit":"","hasThreshold":"N","columnOrder":2},{"sourceColumn":"INTEREST_RATE_PERCENT","sourceType":"double","sourceDataFormat":"","sourceTypeChange":"N","originalSourceType":"double","targetColumn":"INTEREST_RATE_PERCENT","targetType":"decimal(5,2)","targetDataFormat":"","targetTypeChange":"N","orginalTargetType":"decimal(5,2)","unique":"N","upperThreshold":0.0,"lowerThreshold":0.0,"thresholdUnit":"","hasThreshold":"N","columnOrder":3},{"sourceColumn":"LOAN_TYPE","sourceType":"string","sourceDataFormat":"","sourceTypeChange":"N","originalSourceType":"string","targetColumn":"LOAN_TYPE","targetType":"string","targetDataFormat":"","targetTypeChange":"N","orginalTargetType":"string","unique":"N","co
